descripcion: Reglas transversales del MODO FOTO (estilo.modo = "foto", Etapa Foto A). Sustituyen a las de reglas.json, que se escribieron y se aprenden para video cartoon, en todo prompt de un video fotografico. Viven en un fichero aparte porque `asvs actualizar` no sobrescribe reglas.json (es lo que reescribe el destilador en el servidor) y una regla nueva puesta alli no llegaria nunca. Este fichero SI se actualiza con el codigo. Escritas en ingles porque se concatenan tal cual a un prompt en ingles. LAS REGLAS CON `solo_si` SON DE UN TIPO DE VIDEO, NO DE TODOS: solo entran cuando el estilo, la escena o la nota del revisor nombran alguna de sus palabras (expresiones regulares, sin distinguir mayusculas). Las de consolas y videojuegos van asi: el modo foto es para cualquier proyecto, y pedirle a un video de plantas que monte los televisores en su tripode es meterle pantallas y mandos donde no los hay.

reglas.regla: LIGHT AND TIME OF DAY ARE PART OF THE PHOTOGRAPH: every shot has one clear time of day and one consistent light source, and it carries over from the previous shot of the same event unless the scene says otherwise. Indoors, say what lights the room and whether daylight or night shows through the windows. Exposure is set for skin tones.
reglas.por_que: Version fotografica de hora-del-dia-explicita y continuidad-luz-entre-planos: en una foto, un salto de luz entre dos planos del mismo evento delata que se generaron por separado.

reglas.regla: REAL PEOPLE, CAUGHT IN THE MOMENT: everyone in the frame is an ordinary person with natural skin texture, and together they show varied ages, builds, hairstyles and everyday clothes. Nobody poses and nobody looks into the camera unless the scene asks for it. Faces show the expression the scene describes, never a stock-photo smile. Each named person appears only once in the frame, in person, and never also as a photo, poster or face on a screen.
reglas.por_que: El generador tira a la foto de banco de imagenes: todos sonriendo mirando a camara. Y un-personaje-aparece-una-vez vale igual en una foto.

reglas.regla: HANDS ARE PHOTOGRAPHED, NOT INVENTED: every visible hand has five fingers with real anatomy, knuckles and nails, and whatever it holds -- a cup, a phone, a tool, a plant, another hand -- is gripped the way a real hand grips it, never floating. Never extra, fused or missing fingers. When a hand adds nothing to the shot, keep it out of frame rather than render it badly.
reglas.por_que: Las manos son lo primero que delata una foto generada, en cualquier tema. La parte de mandos, volantes y VR es de los videos de consolas y vive en foto-manos-con-mandos.

reglas.regla: GAME CONTROLLERS ARE HELD LIKE THE REAL THING: a game controller with both hands, the right way up, thumbs on the sticks; a racing wheel with both hands; a microphone in one hand near the mouth; VR controllers one in each hand. Never a controller held in one hand or floating.
reglas.por_que: En un servicio de alquiler de consolas las manos con el mando salen en casi todos los planos. Solo cuando el video va de eso.

reglas.regla: GAMING EQUIPMENT IS SET UP LIKE THE REAL THING: every TV stands on its tripod stand or a piece of furniture, never floating and never on the floor; consoles rest on a low table, never on the floor; cables run neatly down the stand to the console and never hang in the air or end in nothing. Screens are switched on, brighter than the room and cast a faint coloured glow on nearby faces and hands; they show generic gameplay that matches what the players are doing, with no game titles, team crests, player names or score overlays.
reglas.por_que: Una pantalla sin soporte, una consola en el suelo o un cable flotando hacen que el montaje parezca falso. Solo en los videos de consolas: en los demas no hay equipo que montar.

reglas.regla: NO THIRD-PARTY BRANDING: no legible logos, brand names, product or title names on screens, clothes, packaging, vehicles or walls. They read as generic: shapes and colours, never a recognisable mark. No watermarks and no captions.
reglas.por_que: Logos y nombres de juegos inventados salen mal escritos y ademas son marcas de otros: en una pieza publicitaria eso es un problema.

reglas.regla: NO LETTERING THAT WAS NOT ASKED FOR: any text in the photograph -- a sign, a banner, a cake topper, a label -- has to be quoted explicitly in this prompt. Any surface that could carry text and was not given any shows none, or shows only illegible shapes. At most ten words in one piece of text, large enough to read at a glance, physically part of the object it is on, and correctly spelled. Text the production asks for is written in the language of the film this prompt states, while real names keep their real-world form.
reglas.por_que: Las tres reglas de texto de reglas.json (permitido pero raro, nada de letras inventadas, el idioma del video) en una sola, escrita para foto.

reglas.regla: IT MUST READ AS A PHOTOGRAPH: real lens optics and depth of field, natural film grain, true colours. Never a CGI, 3D-render, illustration or painted look, never plastic or airbrushed skin, never glossy over-sharpened HDR.
reglas.por_que: Las referencias y la guia empujan a la foto; esta linea cierra la salida por defecto del generador hacia el render limpio.

reglas.regla: A cast sheet in this production is a set of PHOTOGRAPHS of real people. Every face is fully visible, evenly lit, with a neutral and serious expression and nothing covering it by accident (glare, shadow, hair, sunglasses). When the entry is a GROUP, show clearly different individuals -- height, build, hair, skin tone, clothing -- never several views of the same person. Natural skin texture and real hands with five fingers; never a CGI or illustrated look.
reglas.por_que: hoja-reparto-cara-visible y hoja-reparto-grupo-distinta, escritas para foto.
